g.text: How do people spend their time?

text.style: font-size: 11.52px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b5b5b

g.text: Average hours and minutes in a 24-hour day, from surveys run between 2010 and 2024, for people aged 15 to 64.

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #858585

g.text: Note: The chart covers every country whose most recent survey in the OECD database is from 2010 onwards; that survey's year is in brackets. The OECD

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #858585

g.text: flags Mexico's estimates as not fully comparable, because it measures time use differently. In Japan, travel other than commuting counts as unpaid work.
